Arsenal beat Chelsea in London derby

Arsenal scored two goals in the second half to beat Chelsea at the Emirates Stadium on Sunday afternoon. The win moves the north London club to the top of the Premier League table for the first time this season.

The first goal came from a corner in the 54th minute. The ball was headed back across the box, and the captain was there to push it over the line from close range. Chelsea had been the better team in the first half, but they could not keep up the pressure after the break.

The second goal was a beautiful shot from outside the box. The young winger cut inside from the right, beat one defender and curled the ball into the top corner. The crowd stood up and sang his name for several minutes.

After the game, the manager said he was very happy with the reaction of his players. "We worked hard all week, and today we showed how much we want this," he said. "But it is only November. Nobody wins the league in November."

Chelsea will now try to bounce back in the Champions League on Wednesday, when they travel to Germany. Their manager admitted that his team had made too many mistakes. "We gave them two goals," he said. "At this level, you cannot do that and expect to win."

Arsenal play their next league match away at Newcastle on Saturday evening, a ground where they have struggled in recent seasons.
